import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    F = params[0]/np.sqrt(t) + params[1]*np.sqrt(t) + params[2]*np.log(t) + params[3]*t + params[4] + params[5]*np.exp(-t)
    G = params[6]*np.sqrt(t) + params[7] + params[8]*t + params[9]*np.exp(-t)
    return F + G*A**2
